summary: BioNTech SE filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release dated October 13, 2026, announcing first topline results from the AHEAD-MERIT Phase 2/3 trial (NCT04534205) of BNT113 plus pembrolizumab versus pembrolizumab monotherapy in first-line unresectable recurrent or metastatic HPV16-positive head and neck squamous cell carcinoma. The trial missed the progression-free survival dual primary endpoint. The Independent Data Monitoring Committee recommended continuation to assess overall survival, the second dual primary endpoint, where statistical significance could still yield a positive outcome. No deal terms, prices, stakes, premiums, advisors, or transaction mechanics apply; this is a clinical pipeline update, not a special situation. Watch OS readout timing and BNT113 program risk.
